label: saturated near 1; dips in final ~8 trials of episode, deeper after a1->S2
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 3 sits at ~0.9999 (std 0.002) almost everywhere: the unit is essentially frozen. Its only meaningful variation is a dip that grows steeply over the last ~8 trials of the 100-trial episode (down to ~0.97), which the per-decile timing baseline captures only coarsely. A within-final-decile quadratic ramp in ep_trial (per phase, deepest at GO) gives most of the gain (dev R^2 beyond timing 0.39). Behavioural modulators, all scaled by that late ramp: the D1 dip is much deeper after an a1 trial that reached S2 (rare from a1; strongest single extra term, +0.06 dev), a bit deeper when the D1 reward input is 0, and the D2 dip is deeper after choosing a1; the GO policy logit adds nothing. Overall dev 0.47, TEST R^2 beyond timing 0.48 (profile all-cue additive ceiling only 0.06, since those cues are not interacted with late-episode time). Most of the score is finer timing, not trial history, so I rate it partially rather than fully explained. Away from the episode end, history effects are around 1e-4 and not explained. No future variables are used.
